body: Lufia & the Fortress of Doom is Neverland's Super Nintendo role-playing game about the possible return of the Sinistrals, four powerful beings defeated in an earlier age. A descendant of the hero Maxim travels with Lufia and later companions to investigate the threat. The opening lets the player experience the old confrontation before the story moves forward, giving the legend a playable presence. Towns, dungeons and turn-based battles then build a new journey around people who have inherited the consequences of that earlier victory.

Random encounters ask the player to choose physical attacks, spells and other actions for the party. An attack aimed at an enemy already defeated by another companion can be wasted rather than automatically redirected. Planning the round therefore includes estimating how much damage each opponent needs and which character is likely to act first. New equipment and experience increase the party's options, but an efficient encounter still depends on assigning those options sensibly. A routine fight can become costly when several companions commit their efforts to the same target unnecessarily.

Lufia, Aguro and Jerin accompany the hero through kingdoms whose local concerns sit alongside the renewed danger. Conversations develop those relationships between the dungeon expeditions, while towns provide equipment and a place to record progress. Taito published the original game in Japan and North America in 1993. The later Lufia II returned to the earlier generation introduced here, turning the opening's legendary figures into the centre of another adventure. The first game establishes that connection by making inherited history part of an intimate travelling party's present.
